name: Нет контрольного пересчёта остатка
test: Cash received and counted; some banknotes returned to client; remainder accepted/stored or transaction finished without a visible control recount. Require visibility of the full relevant interval; missing sampled action alone is not proof.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: Customer cash was received and counted, then a part of that same cash was returned to that customer.
facts.P2: The remaining cash was accepted/stored or that transaction finished.
facts.P3: The complete relevant interval is visible and the remaining cash was NOT recounted before acceptance/completion. A sampled missing gesture is unknown, not supported.

name: Нет предварительной идентификации
test: Receipt starts without an identity check by physical OR digital document. Require the visible beginning and sufficient opportunity; document handover alone is not proof of identity check, and a cropped start is unknown.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The beginning of a customer cash receipt operation is visible.
facts.P2: Over the complete visible identification opportunity BEFORE receipt, neither a physical NOR digital identity verification occurs. A start outside the clip or unreadable identity procedure is unknown.

must_not_require: A physical document is not required when digital identification is visible.

name: Деньги предыдущего клиента не убраны
test: An earlier customer cash receipt completes; their cash remains outside lockable storage when the next customer operation begins. Track the earlier cash and actual customer change; ordinary current-operation cash on a desk is allowed.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: Two successive customer operations are supported, with the earlier customer cash provenance tracked.
facts.P2: The earlier operation ends before the next operation starts.
facts.P3: That earlier cash remains outside secured storage when the next customer operation starts.

name: Компьютер оставлен без блокировки
test: Cashier leaves and a readable working application/session remains accessible. A lit display alone does not distinguish a lock screen from an application; do not invent unreadable screen contents.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The cashier visibly leaves the workstation.
facts.P2: AFTER departure, a readable working application or active unlocked work session is directly distinguishable on the screen. Lit display, open laptop lid or absence of a visible locking gesture are NOT proof. If screen contents are unreadable, this fact MUST be unknown.

must_not_require: Do not substitute a lit screen or absence of a locking gesture for visible accessible working session.

name: Сейф находится в клиентской зоне
test: Safe containing or used for cash is in the accessible customer side of the service layout. Establish intended cashier/client sides independently of where a person temporarily sits. Door-facing direction or an arbitrary chair does not establish an intended zone. Require independent visible evidence of the functional service boundary/access path; if ambiguous, keep this candidate unconfirmed.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: A visible object is identified as the cash safe, based on use/visible structure.
facts.P2: The intended customer-accessible side is independently established from functional layout/service boundary, not seat or door-facing direction.
facts.P3: The cash safe is physically reachable from that customer side without crossing a secured functional boundary.

name: Кассовая зона оставлена доступной
test: Cashier leaves the cash area and its cash storage/workstation accessible to visitors, with observed unsecured entrance/access. Do not equate an unseen locking gesture with an unlocked door.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The cashier visibly leaves the cash area.
facts.P2: After departure an entrance/barrier is directly seen to permit unsecured access; no locking gesture being observed is insufficient.
facts.P3: Through that observed accessible entrance, visitors can physically reach the cash workspace/storage.

name: Сумка принята без осмотра
test: A bag with bank valuables is received then stored without visible inspection of packaging/lock/seal over the complete visible handover. Do not confuse a personal bag or infer a skipped inspection across unobserved intervals.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: A bank-valuable collection bag, not a personal bag, is visibly received.
facts.P2: That received bag is then put into storage.
facts.P3: Across the completely visible relevant handover-to-storage interval, the required packaging/lock/seal inspection is visibly skipped. Unobserved intervals make this unknown.

name: Перекрытие операций клиентов
test: A second customer money/document operation begins while the first customer operation is still unfinished. Two people in the room or a companion alone do not establish two transactions.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: Two separate customer money/document operations, not companions or internal work, are visibly established.
facts.P2: The second operation begins while the first operation is visibly unfinished.

name: Сейф оставлен открытым
test: Cash is removed from the safe, cashier returns to other work, and the safe door visibly remains open. A briefly opened safe during active access alone is ordinary.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The cashier visibly removes cash from the safe.
facts.P2: The cashier finishes that safe access and returns to unrelated work or leaves.
facts.P3: After that safe-access completion, the same safe door visibly remains open. Brief active access alone is not a violation.

name: Ключ от сейфа оставлен без присмотра
test: Cashier visibly handles a safe key, leaves it on the safe/accessible surface, and leaves without taking/securing it. A small unidentified object, a hand gesture, or an invisible key is insufficient.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: An identifiable key associated with the safe is directly visible, not just an unidentified small object or lock/hand gesture.
facts.P2: The cashier places/leaves that safe key on an unsecured accessible surface.
facts.P3: The cashier subsequently leaves and that same key visibly remains there without being retrieved or secured; retain the object continuity.

must_not_require: No customer, cash transaction, open safe door, or key inserted in a lock is required.

name: Ключ оставлен в замке сейфа
test: Key is visibly left inserted in the safe lock after safe work ends and cashier switches to other work/leaves. Do not infer a key solely from a lock-shaped dark spot or a prior window with no visible key.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: An identifiable key is directly visible inserted in the safe lock. A dark lock spot or hand gesture alone is unknown.
facts.P2: Safe work ends and the cashier switches to other work OR leaves.
facts.P3: After that transition the same key visibly remains inserted in the lock.

must_not_require: The cashier need not leave the room; switching to other work is sufficient. No visible customer or cash handover is required.

name: Наличные оставлены без присмотра
test: Cashier leaves the room/workplace while identifiable banknotes remain on the desk outside secured storage. Client absence alone does not establish cashier absence.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The cashier visibly leaves the room/workplace, rather than just a client leaving.
facts.P2: After that departure identifiable banknotes remain on the desk outside secured storage.

name: Клиент вошёл в рабочую зону
test: An identified client moves behind the cashier or onto the cashier side with direct access to cash equipment. A reflection is not another person; a cashier changing position is not client intrusion. Door-facing direction or an arbitrary chair does not establish an intended zone. Require independent visible evidence of the functional service boundary/access path; if ambiguous, keep this candidate unconfirmed.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The moving person is independently identified as a customer from their operational behavior, not appearance or seat.
facts.P2: The intended cashier side is independently established from the functional service boundary/equipment layout.
facts.P3: That customer crosses into that cashier side or behind the cashier with direct access to cash equipment.

name: Не разделены кассовая и клиентская зоны
test: Layout permits incoming visitors direct passage behind cashier to cash equipment/safe without a separating barrier. Merely sharing one room is not sufficient; identify actual access path and intended zones. Door-facing direction or an arbitrary chair does not establish an intended zone. Require independent visible evidence of the functional service boundary/access path; if ambiguous, keep this candidate unconfirmed.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: An intended cashier/customer functional boundary and cash equipment/access path are independently established.
facts.P2: The visible layout permits visitors direct passage behind the cashier to cash equipment/safe without a separating barrier.

name: Кассир работает со стороны клиента
test: The same cashier occupies the intended customer seat/side and handles cash or equipment there while the intended cashier workplace remains unused. Role follows the person, not the chair. Door-facing direction or an arbitrary chair does not establish an intended zone. Require independent visible evidence of the functional service boundary/access path; if ambiguous, keep this candidate unconfirmed.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The same operator is independently identified as cashier by responsibility for bank operations.
facts.P2: The intended customer side/seat is independently established from service layout, not orientation or arbitrary chair.
facts.P3: That cashier performs cash/equipment work from that customer side while the intended cashier workplace is unused.

name: Пересчёт денег клиента без клиента
test: Customer cash is being received/counted while that customer has left/is visibly absent. Link cash to customer receipt. Internal safe cash inventory/counting alone with no customer transaction is ordinary.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The counted/received cash is linked to a visible customer receipt operation, not internal inventory or own money.
facts.P2: The cashier receives/counts that customer cash.
facts.P3: At that same receipt/counting interval the corresponding customer has visibly left or is visibly absent.

name: Наличные разных клиентов не разделены
test: Old customer cash stays on desk and new customer cash is placed beside it before old cash is secured. Require two supported customer transactions and separate cash provenance, not an arbitrary split of one customer pile.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: Two distinct customer cash transactions and the provenance of their separate funds are visibly established; two companions or one split pile do not suffice.
facts.P2: The earlier customer cash remains on the work surface outside secured storage when the newer operation begins.
facts.P3: New customer cash is placed beside that earlier cash before the earlier cash is secured; physical combining is NOT required.

must_not_require: Do not require physical mixing, simultaneous handover or absence of the earlier client. Adjacent cash from the two operations suffices.

name: Смешаны деньги разных клиентов
test: Cash from two supported customer transactions is physically combined in one pile. Require ownership continuity and observed combining; adjacent piles alone are not mixing.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: Cash from two distinct supported customer transactions has separate established provenance.
facts.P2: Those funds are visibly physically combined into one pile; adjacent distinct piles alone are insufficient.

name: Личные вещи на рабочей поверхности
test: Cashier places identifiable personal bag/outerwear on cash working surface. Track possession by cashier. A customer coat, collection bag, work tray, or mere proximity is insufficient.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The owner/handler of the item is the cashier, supported by the same person continuing operational work. A single operator can be cashier without a customer; changing clothing/seat does not change role.
facts.P2: An identifiable personal outerwear item of that cashier is placed OR rests on the cash working surface at some visible point. Evaluate the coat alone: absence/location/timing of a bag CANNOT negate this fact.
facts.P3: An identifiable personal bag of that cashier is placed OR rests on the cash working surface at some visible point. Evaluate the bag alone: absence/location/timing of a coat CANNOT negate this fact.

must_not_require: No simultaneous coat AND bag placement. EITHER coat OR bag suffices.
No customer, cash transaction, counting money, prolonged stay or interruption of work is required.
The coat and bag need not be on the table at the same time; no shared timestamp across P2/P3.

name: Деньги оставлены при личных действиях
test: After counting, cashier leaves banknotes unsecured on desk and switches to an unrelated personal activity such as drinking. Establish the operation transition and money location, not just the presence of a cup.
source: User annotated workbook; development operational definition, not an independently verified legal rule

facts.P1: The cashier has visibly finished counting identifiable banknotes.
facts.P2: Those same banknotes remain unsecured on the desk.
facts.P3: While those banknotes remain unsecured, the cashier switches to unrelated personal activity, such as drinking, rather than continued bank operation.
